help.title: SIF Help Center
help.subtitle: Step-by-step guides for managing patients, appointments and nutrition plans
help.no_results_desc: We couldn't find help matching your search. Try using different keywords.

login.title: Sign In
login.description: Access SIF using your Keycloak credentials.
steps: Open the SIF sign-in page
Enter your Keycloak username and password
Click 'Sign In' to access the dashboard

switch_tenant.title: Switch Clinic
switch_tenant.description: Switch between different clinics you belong to.
steps: Click your avatar in the top right corner
Select 'Switch Clinic' from the dropdown menu
Choose the desired clinic and the page will reload

recover_password.title: Recover Password
recover_password.description: Reset your password if you forgot it.
steps: On the login screen, click 'Forgot your password?'
Enter your registered email address
Check your inbox and follow the link to reset it

theme.title: Dark / Light Theme
steps: Click your avatar in the top right corner
Select 'Theme' and choose Light, Dark, or System

language.title: Change Language
steps: Click the language icon in the top right corner
Select 'English' or 'Español' as preferred

notifications.title: Notification Preferences
notifications.description: Configure how you receive alerts and notices.
steps: Click your avatar → Preferences → Notifications
Enable or disable email, push, and in-app alerts

keyboard.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
steps: Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) to open global search
Use Tab and arrows to move between elements
Press Escape to close dialogs and menus

search.title: Global Search
steps: Press Ctrl+K to open the search bar
Type a patient name, appointment, or section

breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumb Navigation
breadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumbs show your current location. The top breadcrumb trail lets you return to previous sections with one click.

overview.title: Dashboard Overview
overview.description: Main view with key metrics for your clinic.

widgets.title: Dashboard Widgets
widgets.description: Cards with stats: patients, appointments, revenue.
steps: Each widget shows a main KPI
Click a widget to view full details

quick_actions.title: Quick Actions
steps: On the dashboard, locate the quick actions bar
Click 'New Patient', 'New Appointment', or 'New Menu'

appointments_proposed.title: Appointment Proposals
steps: On the dashboard, check the 'Appointment Proposals' widget
Accept, reschedule, or reject each proposal

list_view.title: Patient List View
list_view.description: Main table with all your patients.

search_filter.title: Search and Filter Patients
steps: Use the top search bar for name or email
Apply filters: status, assigned nutritionist, dates

invite_patient.title: Invite New Patient
invite_patient.description: Add a patient by sending an invitation.
steps: Click 'New Patient' in the top bar
Fill in name, email, and optional data
The patient receives an email to complete registration

edit_patient.title: Edit Patient Data
steps: In the list, click the menu (⋮) for the patient
Select 'Edit' and modify the needed fields
Save changes

activate_deactivate.title: Activate / Deactivate Patient
steps: In the patient menu, choose 'Activate' or 'Deactivate'
Confirm the action in the dialog

view_details.title: View Patient Detail
view_details.description: Access the full profile with tabs.
steps: Click the patient name in the list
Navigate tabs: Profile, Measurements, Menus, History

measurements_tab.title: Measurements Tab
measurements_tab.description: Weight, height, BMI history and charts.
steps: In patient detail, go to the 'Measurements' tab
View evolution charts and add new records

menus_assigned.title: Assigned Menus
menus_assigned.description: Active nutrition plans for the patient.
steps: In the 'Menus' tab, view assigned plans
Click one to see details or edit

invite_staff.title: Invite Staff
invite_staff.description: Add nutritionists, receptionists, or other roles.
steps: In Staff, click 'Invite Staff'
Enter email, select role and permissions
The invitee receives an email to join the clinic

edit_permissions.title: Edit Permissions
edit_permissions.description: Adjust what each member can see and do.
steps: In the list, click the menu (⋮) for the user
Select 'Permissions' and check/uncheck access
Save changes

remove_staff.title: Remove Staff
steps: In the user menu, choose 'Remove'
Confirm the action (irreversible)

create_appointment.title: Create Appointment
steps: In the calendar, click a free time slot
Select patient, type, duration, and notes
Save the appointment

edit_appointment.title: Edit Appointment
steps: Click the appointment in the calendar
Change time, patient, type, or notes
Save

cancel_appointment.title: Cancel Appointment
steps: Click the appointment → 'Cancel'
Optionally add a reason and confirm

proposals.title: Appointment Proposals
steps: In the notification bell or dashboard, see 'Proposals'
Accept, reschedule, or reject each one

recurring.title: Recurring Appointments
steps: When creating an appointment, enable 'Repeat'
Define frequency (weekly, biweekly, monthly) and end
Save the series

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.description: Manage patients waiting for an opening.
steps: On a full appointment, add patient to 'Waitlist'
If a slot opens, notify the patient from there

invoices_list.title: Invoices List
steps: Go to Revenue → Invoices
Filter by date, patient, status, amount

create_invoice.title: Create Invoice
steps: In Invoices, click 'New Invoice'
Select patient, line items, amount, and VAT
Generate and send by email

charts_metrics.title: Charts and Metrics
charts_metrics.description: Visual analysis of revenue by period.
steps: In Revenue, go to the 'Charts' tab
Select period and grouping (day/week/month)

time_granularity.title: Time Granularity
time_granularity.description: Change the time scale in charts.
steps: In charts, use the selector: Day, Week, Month
Data aggregates automatically

filter_by_staff.title: Filter by Professional
filter_by_staff.description: View revenue attributed to each nutritionist.
steps: In list or charts, open the 'Professional' filter
Select one or more to see their billing

export_data.title: Export Data
export_data.description: Download reports as CSV or PDF.
steps: In any list or chart, click 'Export'
Choose CSV (raw data) or PDF (visual report)

create_menu.title: Create Menu
create_menu.description: Design a nutrition plan from scratch.
steps: Go to Nutrition → Menus → 'New Menu'
Define name, patient, days, and target calories
Add meals by dragging recipes or creating free ones

menu_from_template.title: Menu from Template
menu_from_template.description: Use a base template to save time.
steps: In 'New Menu', choose 'From template'
Select template and target patient
Customize days and meals as needed

edit_menu.title: Edit Menu
steps: In the menus list, click the menu (⋮) → Edit
Change recipes, quantities, days, or targets
Save

assign_menu.title: Assign Menu to Patient
assign_menu.description: Link a menu to a specific patient.
steps: In the menu, click 'Assign'
Search and select the patient
Set start date and duration

create_template.title: Create Template
create_template.description: Save a menu as a reusable template.
steps: In an edited menu, click 'Save as template'
Provide name, description, and category
The template will be available for new menus

template_library.title: Template Library
steps: Go to Nutrition → Templates
Search, edit, duplicate, or delete templates

meal_suggestions.title: Meal Suggestions
meal_suggestions.description: Get automatic proposals based on preferences.
steps: In the patient's menu, click 'Suggest Meal'
Filter by allergies, preferences, and meal type
Review options in the recipe library
Click to add to patient's menu
Meal is added with automatic macronutrients

education_resources.title: Share Educational Resources
education_resources.description: Send guides, articles, and videos to your patients.
steps: Go to Nutrition → Resources
Select available articles, videos, or guides
Click 'Share with Patient'
Select patient or group
Resources appear in patient's dashboard

clinic_profile.title: Clinic Profile
clinic_profile.description: Tax data, logo, and contact for the clinic.
steps: Go to Settings → Clinic Profile
Fill in name, tax ID, address, phone, email
Upload logo (used on invoices and patient portal)

branding.title: Visual Branding
steps: In Settings → Branding
Choose primary color, secondary color, and dark mode
Preview and save

billing_settings.title: Billing Settings
billing_settings.description: Series, numbering, VAT, and invoice templates.
steps: In Settings → Billing
Define series, counter, default VAT
Upload custom invoice template (optional)

appointment_settings.title: Appointment Settings
appointment_settings.description: Durations, types, reminders, and time slots.
steps: In Settings → Appointments
Define appointment types, durations, and colors
Configure automatic reminders (email/SMS)

nutrition_settings.title: Nutrition Settings
steps: In Settings → Nutrition
Set default macros, units (g/kcal)
Manage food library and base recipes

overview.title: My Dashboard
overview.description: Personal summary: next appointment, active menu, progress.

next_appointment.title: Next Appointment
next_appointment.description: View and manage your upcoming appointment.
steps: On the dashboard, your next appointment is highlighted
Click to view details, confirm, or cancel

active_menu.title: Active Menu
active_menu.description: Your current nutrition plan day by day.
steps: On the dashboard, the 'Active Menu' card shows today
Click to see the full week and details

progress_charts.title: Progress Charts
steps: On the dashboard, scroll to 'My Progress'
Select time range and metric to visualize

view_menu.title: View My Menu
steps: Go to 'My Diets' in the main menu
Select the active menu to see days and meals

meal_detail.title: Meal Detail
steps: In your menu, click any meal
See recipe, ingredients, macros, and instructions

swap_meal.title: Swap Meal
swap_meal.description: Replace a meal with another from the library.
steps: In a meal detail, click 'Swap'
Choose alternative filtering by type and preferences
Confirm the change

adherence.title: Adherence Tracking
adherence.description: Mark meals as done and see your compliance %.
steps: In your menu, mark each meal as 'Done'
The dashboard shows your weekly adherence percentage

history.title: Diet History
history.description: Access previous menus and their results.
steps: In My Diets, use the 'Previous Menus' selector
Review past menus, adherence, and evolution

view_list.title: View Shopping List
view_list.description: Consolidated ingredients from your weekly menu.

grouped_by_store.title: Grouped by Store
grouped_by_store.description: Organize the list by supermarket or section.
steps: In the list, enable 'Group by store/section'
Items sort for an efficient shopping route

mark_purchased.title: Mark Purchased
mark_purchased.description: Check off items as you buy them.
steps: Tap the checkbox next to each ingredient
The top counter shows pending/bought

share_list.title: Share List
share_list.description: Send the list via email or WhatsApp.
steps: In the list, click 'Share'
Choose an app or copy the link to send

personal_data.title: Personal Data
personal_data.description: Name, email, phone, date of birth.

measurements.title: My Measurements
measurements.description: Log weight, height, and see automatic BMI.
steps: Go to My Profile → Measurements → 'New Record'
Enter weight and height, BMI calculates automatically

water_consumption.title: Water Consumption
steps: In My Profile → Water, use the +/− buttons
Daily goal configurable in Settings

clinical_info.title: Clinical Information
steps: In My Profile → Clinical, fill in each section
Your nutritionist sees this to personalize your plan

events.title: My Timeline
events.description: Chronological history of appointments, measurements, and changes.
steps: In My Profile → Events, filter by type and date
Each entry shows what, when, and who

my_appointments.title: My Appointments
my_appointments.description: List of all your past and future appointments.

theme_preference.title: Theme Preference
theme_preference.description: Choose light, dark, or follow system.
steps: Go to Settings → Theme
Select Light, Dark, or System

language_preference.title: Language Preference
steps: Go to Settings → Language
Choose your preferred language

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Configure appointment, menu, and reminder alerts.
steps: In Settings → Notifications
Enable/disable email, push, and in-app reminders

account_info.title: Account Information
account_info.description: View your email, change password, and access data.
